snippet.title: Vortex 9 - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Vortex 9 is an online shooter with stylish brawlers, insane weapons, explosive shooting battles and cute pets! Supporting cross play with VR, mobile and desktop versions. Find yourself in a totally strange and attractive world of fighting cat-people and speaking robots. Is it a demon girl attacking you with a big gun? Who is this guy with a box instead of his head and a bat in his paws? No worries! Get your battle lollipop or a bubble shooting gun and show them who’s the boss!
